note: File Link provides the 'file_link' field type (Drupal\file_link\Plugin\Field\FieldType\FileLinkItem, extends core LinkItem): a link that must point at a file and stores the target's size (int) and format (MIME) columns, fetched via HTTP on save (or via the file_link_metadata_update queue worker on cron when deferred). Per-field settings: file_extensions (default 'txt'), no_extension (bool), deferred_request (bool). Widget file_link_default; formatters file_link / file_link_separate (option format_size). Validation constraint LinkToFile. Site-wide settings.php flags: file_link.follow_redirect_on_validate (default TRUE), file_link.disable_http_requests (default FALSE). No configure route, no permissions, no Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real field config (a file_link field on Article, its file_extensions/deferred_request settings), verified against field storage/field config - no external file fetch needed.

evals.prompt: How does the file_link module extend a core Link field, and what extra data does its field type store about the target?
evals.expected_output: file_link adds a 'file_link' field type (extends the core LinkItem) whose link must point at a file. On save it stores extra metadata about the target file: its size (bytes) and format (MIME type), fetched from the URL's Content-Length/Content-Type headers.

evals.prompt: With the file_link field type, how do I restrict which target file types are allowed (e.g. only PDFs), and which setting controls it?
evals.expected_output: Set the field's 'file_extensions' setting (a space-separated list, default 'txt') to the allowed extensions, e.g. 'pdf'. The LinkToFile constraint then rejects links whose target isn't a file with an allowed extension (unless no_extension is enabled).

evals.prompt: I'm bulk-importing thousands of nodes that have file_link fields and don't want each save to make an HTTP request to fetch file metadata. What options does file_link give me to avoid or defer those requests?
evals.expected_output: Either enable the field's deferred_request setting (metadata is fetched later by cron via the file_link_metadata_update queue worker instead of on save), or set $settings['file_link.disable_http_requests'] = TRUE in settings.php to disable all HTTP requests. You can also set file_link.follow_redirect_on_validate = FALSE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a file_link field named field_flink_known. Inspect the live field configuration and report which target file extensions it allows.
evals.expected_output: field_flink_known allows 'pdf epub' (field setting file_extensions), read from field.field.node.article.field_flink_known.settings.file_extensions.

evals.prompt: The Article field field_flink_known on this site is a file_link field. Inspect its live configuration and state whether its file metadata (size/format) is fetched immediately on save or deferred to cron.
evals.expected_output: It is deferred: field_flink_known has deferred_request = TRUE, so size/format are updated by cron (the file_link_metadata_update queue worker), not immediately on save.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a field named field_flink_task to the Article content type using the file_link field type, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A field storage node.field_flink_task of type file_link exists with a matching field on the article bundle.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a file_link field field_flink_cfg that currently only allows .txt targets. Change its configuration so it also allows PDF files, and save it to the live site.
